subject: corpus_inputs plan: auditable missing-input materialization harness (no ABI edits)
body:
Read HANDOFF/TASK/board. Starting the missing-input harness now; no production/ABI/device/commit work.

PLAN (new gpu/tools/audit_shader_pipeline_inputs.py, private evidence under workers/corpus_inputs/):
1. Frozen-input manifest: one row per installed corpus entry with air/lib SHA256, entry name, stage, current coverage status, extraction exclusion, and declared constants (name/type/index/flags from functions.json). No corpus mutation.
2. Function-constant materialization: use the EXISTING exported bridge symbol tegu_air_library_specialize (present in frozen baseline libtegu_air_bridge.so) to build a specialized library snapshot per candidate; then translate with the existing compile entries. Each constant records origin=captured|inferred|synthetic, declared type/index, byte width, exact value, and whether that value is app-observed or a diagnostic branch choice. No silent zero fill; a value concluded only from a module declaration is labelled declaration-only.
3. Graphics descriptor materialization for the208 audit_descriptor_insufficient rows: derive per-slot declared output/input target types from the saved AIR LLVM metadata, build a finite labelled attachment-set matrix using only formats the frozen render ABI accepts (R8/RGBA8/BGRA8/RGBA16F), and separate (a) translation now succeeds, (b) bridge format surface cannot express integer/narrow targets, (c) bridge rejects expanded (tessellation) topology. Patch/tess cases get explicit PerPatchControlPoint/PerPatch layout variants; if translation succeeds but stages.len()!=2, classify as bridge topology, not missing input.
4. Isolation/resume: one subprocess per candidate, AS/CPU/wall caps, workers=1 default, done.json keyed by exact input+compiler+value hash; representative categories first, then request a root batch lease. Compiler hash recorded from the frozen .so; no build.
5. Outputs: manifest.jsonl, variants.jsonl, results.jsonl, summary.json + a short tests file. Statuses are separate for translation/descriptor/native compile; synthetic branches are never counted as exact application behavior.

Inputs requested (non-blocking): corpus (Codex) - confirm the exact per-slot render_target metadata shape and whether captured descriptor recipes beyond quartzcore_catalog_recipes exist; frontend_audit/lowering - confirm that tegu_air_library_specialize + existing compile entries is the intended offline route and that no new production symbol is needed for audit-only constant materialization. I will not edit any production file. I will post representative results, then ask root for a full selected-category batch lease.
